items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: But I taught him every lick of it, and I recorded "Strike Up the Band."

ctx.x: And -- I made the deal. And I got it. And I was there so many days -- you know, when they're shooting, they had to have me there because they didn't know when they would get to me -- when they would get to the part where they needed me.
But I taught him every lick of it, and I recorded "Strike Up the Band." I don't know if you ever saw the picture, but ...
So Mickey Rooney never had played any drums until then.
